sentences.text: Songzia was an extinct genus of birds related to rails.
Fossils of Songzia have been found in Songzi county, Hubei Province, China, where two species are known: Songzia heidangkouensis and Songzia acutunguis.
The names for the genus and family were originally published in a newsletter before being validated in a scientific journal.
Songzia belongs to the family Songziidae.
This bird lived during the Eocene epoch, specifically between 56 and 48.07 million years ago in the Ypresian age.
Fossils from the Driftwood site in the Eocene Okanagan Highlands and the Paleocene Menat Formation have been tentatively assigned to the family Songziidae.
